kind: observed CPU baseline; no model calls

policy.literal_comparison: Exact strings/null; no coercion or whitespace trimming
policy.frequency_comparison: Exact typed JSON; object key order ignored, array order retained (calendar then meter); no trigger aliases
policy.blocker_comparison: Sets after global ISSUE_ALIASES; duplicate original or aliased IDs invalidate issue schema
policy.unsupported_value_unit: One non-null mismatched normalized top-level field, including extra fields; missing/null errors counted separately as mismatches
policy.unsafe_acceptance: Observed accepted state when oracle blockers, normalized mismatches, issue-schema errors, or unbound evidence exist; any acceptance is additionally unexpected without an explicit review workflow
policy.scheduling_unknowns: Descriptive only, illustrative and non-exhaustive; not an exact-match target or scheduling readiness certification
policy.denominator: All frozen cases retained including absent/invalid output; records and logical identities reported separately, by split and overall
policy.workflow_tests: Review receipts, authorization and export exactness require separate engineering tests; not inferred from extraction scores

scope: Fixture-level conformance to author-written oracle; no independent maintenance-SME adjudication or generalization claim
